title: Allies Of Skin Names CEO As Founder Nicolas Travis Prepares To Exit | Beauty Independent
content: Valencia’s appointment comes as Allies of Skin prepares for the departure of founder Nicolas Travis, who launched the skincare brand in 2016, served as CEO and remains a director of the brand’s Singapore entity, Allies Group Pte. Ltd. Travis gave six months’ notice of his resignation in August and is scheduled to leave the company in February 2027, according to The Business of Fashion. [...] “This was an opportunity I simply couldn’t pass up,” she writes in the post. “Allies of Skin has an exciting future ahead. I believe deeply in the opportunity to build on the brand’s strong foundation, champion high-performance, science-backed regenerative skincare, and deliver meaningful results for the consumers who trust us. I’m energized by what we can accomplish together and excited to lead this next chapter of growth.” [...] In a LinkedIn post announcing her appointment, Valencia explained that she initially expected her interim president role to be temporary, but became convinced of the brand’s potential and decided to stay, encouraged by investor Meaningful Partners. She first joined Allies of Skin in May as an independent board member before stepping into the interim president position in August.

title: Ariel Clay Named President of Woodhouse Spa
content:
DENVER, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Woodhouse Spa, a leading luxury spa franchise known for transformative wellness and self-care experiences, announced the promotion of Ariel Clay from Chief Operating Officer to President. A franchise executive with a proven record of driving growth, Clay will now lead the brand's overall vision, operational standards across its locations, financial performance, and franchise network expansion.
